'''Chris Gregg''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 36 from Austin, Tx. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
